title: World Evolution Soccer
native_title: ワールド・エボリューション・サッカー
overview: World Evolution Soccer is a soccer game featuring 32 national teams with no official league license. Three modes are included: a World Cup season mode, a single-match Exhibition mode, and a Party Mode for a four-team mini-tournament. A notable feature is the high level of team formation and strategy customization, allowing the player to tweak how the CPU controls their team's players; this can be adjusted not just before a game but also during breaks in a match.
